name: rules-rtdb-r53-deploy-regex-paren
description: RTDB rules deploy verdicts for corpus scenario "r53-deploy-regex-paren" (rtdb#71). Captured by dry-run deploys to the rules endpoint, which validate without deploying. pyric reports unmatched parentheses in regex literals with positions only one production observation supports; anchored and stray-parenthesis positions, unclosed repeat counts, empty alternatives and empty character sets have no production text.

unclosed ( after a leading ^ (/^(/).error: Illegal regular expression, expected ')' at position 3

unclosed ( between anchors (/^(a$/).error: Illegal regular expression, expected ')' at position 2

unclosed ( mid-pattern (/a(b/).error: Illegal regular expression, expected ')' at position 7

unclosed repeat count (/a{2/).error: Illegal regular expression, expected '}' at position 5

empty character set (/^[]$/).error: Illegal regular expression, expected ']' at position 2
